26fyw6kffxym.body:
After extensive monitoring and coordination with our platform provider over the past months, we must inform you that Genesys Cloud services in the EMEA (UAE) region will remain unavailable until further notice. The continued infrastructure challenges in the region have prevented the platform provider from restoring core services necessary to support Genesys Cloud operations. Based on the latest guidance received, full recovery of this region is unknown. 

Existing customers with data or configurations in this region should have already initiated migration to alternate regions. We strongly advise all affected customers to continue operating in alternate regions that remain fully operational, work with your Genesys Cloud account team to evaluate and complete migration options to alternative AWS regions, and export critical data and configurations to ensure business continuity. 

Genesys remains in close communication with the platform provider and will continue to monitor this situation closely. If you have questions or still require assistance with migration planning, please contact your Genesys Cloud account team. This page will be updated monthly or sooner as information becomes available.

This incident has caused widespread service disruptions impacting core platform functions including database operations, virtual machine provisioning, monitoring systems, message processing, storage operations, and automated workflows, with no estimated time for recovery. This post consolidates the previous announcement due to the volume of updates previously provided, and Genesys will continue to share updates as new information becomes available. We strongly recommend all affected customers migrate workloads to alternate AWS regions, work with your Genesys Cloud account team on migration planning, and export critical data and configurations to ensure business continuity if not already done so. Please contact your Genesys Cloud account team if you need assistance or have questions.
